source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Keep the auto-injector indefinitely because epinephrine does not lose potency with time","B":"Store the auto-injector in extreme heat or cold because temperature does not affect it","C":"Check expiration and solution appearance regularly and replace the device when indicated","D":"Use the auto-injector even when the solution is cloudy, discolored, or contains particles"}}
source_row.rationale: Clients should be taught to regularly check the expiration date of their epinephrine auto-injector and replace it before expiration, since expired epinephrine may have reduced potency and effectiveness during a life-threatening anaphylactic reaction. The device should also be stored at controlled room temperature and inspected for discoloration or particulates, which would indicate it should be replaced.
source_row.source_detail: Storage/handling: controlled room temperature, inspect solution, replace if discolored/cloudy/particulate and replace before expiration; revised 2023-02; accessed 2026-08-14.
